candidate_area_name: Six legacy units named in 2012/2013 local formation evidence
assessment: exact arithmetic baseline, geometry not verified
notes: Gräsmyr 4795 + Mullsjö 3492 + Tallbergslidens 3172 + Hummelholm 5508 + Hörnsjö 6601 + Torrböle 3209 = 26777 ha. Exact match to reported Hörneåns 2013/2014 area does not prove identical polygons.

Djupsjö 2506 + Nyåker 2568 + registration 183 504 = 5578 ha. Local 2014 list names Djupsjö Högland Nyåker, but registration 183 has blank portal name and must not be labelled Högland without evidence.

The legacy 2012 allocation list gives Öre-Brattfors VVO 3151 ha, exactly matching Hörneåns reported increase from 32355 to 35506 ha. This is the leading candidate for the added area, but no historical decision/map yet proves it was added to Hörneåns in 2018/2019.
Small reported change could be a land-register/geometric recalculation or a small boundary adjustment
Hallens old listed area 1553 ha is 12.75 ha below the increase. Do not treat as identified addition
